chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample C, 4/5
chunks.content: Sample C scored 4/5 (Well-Supported, Articulate Argument Conveying a New Understanding). Topic: Disney's depiction (of a group/theme), investigated via content analysis with a focused research question. The paper conveys a well-supported new understanding but stays at 4 rather than 5 because the analysis/conclusions do not fully address a gap in the research base or engage broader implications/limitations as richly as a 5. Illustrates the 4-vs-5 boundary: articulate and supported, but not the richest analysis.
